description: Implementation of signal handling, including installation and uninstallation of signal handlers, handling fatal signals, and thread-safe signal management within the PyTorch c10 namespace.

classes.name: SignalHandler
classes.description: Handles SIGINT and SIGHUP signals, allowing configuration of actions and signal state querying.

classes.name: FatalSignalHandler
classes.description: Manages installation of fatal signal handlers, captures stack traces, and coordinates thread signal handling for fatal signals.

methods.name: SignalHandler::GotSIGINT
methods.description: Checks if SIGINT was received since last call.

methods.name: SignalHandler::GotSIGHUP
methods.description: Checks if SIGHUP was received since last call.

methods.name: SignalHandler::CheckForSignals
methods.description: Returns the configured action based on received signals.

methods.name: FatalSignalHandler::setPrintStackTracesOnFatalSignal
methods.description: Enables or disables printing stack traces on fatal signals.

methods.name: FatalSignalHandler::printStackTracesOnFatalSignal
methods.description: Returns whether printing stack traces on fatal signals is enabled.
